entities.summary: Alexandre Chatrian was a French writer, associated with the region of Alsace-Lorraine. Almost all of his works were written jointly with Émile Erckmann under the name Erckmann-Chatrian. Alexandre Chatrian was a authors & novelists from Grand Soldat (1826-12-18, Grand Soldat–1890-09-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
